description: Customer orders placed in the portal are submitted for validation
Field sales orders are submitted for validation
Order lines are priced against customer price lists
Validated orders are released to the warehouse for picking
Dispatch manifests are handed to route planning
Planned routes are registered for temperature monitoring
Temperature records are extracted for compliance reporting
Trade account master data is published to order capture
Trade account master data is published to the portal
Customer hierarchy is published to pricing
Trade accounts and credit terms are published to billing
Trade account data is published to field sales
Customer dimension is loaded for reporting
Fulfilled orders are handed to billing for invoicing
Invoices and receipts are posted to the general ledger
Stock movements and valuations are posted to the ledger
Product data and imagery are published to the portal
Product data is published to field sales
Product master is published to order capture
Forecast demand informs replenishment planning
Confirmed purchase orders are registered for receiving
Order history is extracted to train the forecast
Shift rosters are keyed into the warehouse system by hand
Employee changes are sent to the payroll bureau
Absence data is exported for scheduling
Order and margin data is loaded for reporting
